latvia.title: Police find €3,000 in cash in pockets of suspected money mule
latvia.description: Officers from the Northern Prefecture detained a 37‑year‑old Latvian resident in Tallinn on Monday, discovering €3,000 in cash in his pockets. Police believe he acted as a money mule in a series of fraud cases.

latvia.title: 63 migrants from Belarus caught in Estonia last week and more expected, PPA says
latvia.description: Over the past week, 63 migrants with no legal right to be in Estonia have been caught by the police – almost double the number apprehended last year. The authorities say the situation is connected to the migration pressure on the Latvian-Belarus border and will likely continue until the weather worsens.

latvia.title: Minister: Estonia sends extra border guards to Latvia as Belarus drives migrant surge
latvia.description: Estonia will send additional police and border guard forces to Latvia to strengthen the European Union's external border. The decision came after several dozen illegal migrants who entered the country through Belarus and Latvia were detained in Estonia in recent days.

latvia.title: BLOGI ⟩ 1619. sõjapäev Ukrainas: Zelenskõi andmetel kasutas Venemaa õhurünnakus Põhja-Korea raketti
latvia.description: 2022. aasta 24. veebruaril alustas Venemaa režiimi juht Vladimir Putin sissetungi Ukrainasse. Pärast seda, kui Ukraina lõi tagasi pealetungi Kiievile, on lahingute kese kandunud Ida- ja Lõuna-Ukrainasse. Postimees kajastab 1619. sõjapäeva sündmusi allolevas blogis.

latvia.title: Poola kaalub Ukrainale täiendavate Patrioti rakettide andmist
latvia.description: Poola peaminister Donald Tusk teatas neljapäeval, et Varssavi kaalub täiendavate Patrioti rakettide üleandmist Kiievile pärast seda, kui öösel kukkus Ida-Poolas põllule Vene rakett, teatas ajaleht Kyiv Independent.

latvia.title: Bildt: Putini kangekaelsus veab teda Ukrainas halvima suunas
latvia.description: Venemaa diktaator Vladimir Putin peaks nõustuma relvarahuga Ukrainas praegusel kontaktjoonel, mis on talle praeguses olukorras parim valik, avaldas neljapäeval väljaande Kyiv Independent külaliskolumnis arvamust Rootsi endine peaminister ja välisminister Carl Bildt.

latvia.title: Zelenskõi andmetel kasutas Venemaa õhurünnakus Põhja-Korea raketti
latvia.description: Esialgsed andmed viitavad sellele, et Venemaa kasutas Dnipropetrovski oblastis asuva Radušne küla ründamiseks Põhja-Korea ballistilist raketti, ütles neljapäeval Ukraina president Volodõmõr Zelenskõi.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 30th July, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Decisions, decisions: Latvian government says airBaltic's future depends upon its creditors
latvia.description: On July 30th, Latvian Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs (United List) chaired a closed extraordinary meeting of the Cabinet of Ministers (in the 'Secure Negotiations Room') at the main government building in Rīga.

latvia.title: Livonian festival taking place this weekend
latvia.description: At the end of July, you can go to Latvia's western Kurzeme region not only to sunbathe, but also to get to know and celebrate the region's Livonian heritage.

latvia.title: Economics Minister proposes banning overcrowded living among foreigners
latvia.description: The Minister for Economic Affairs, Viktors Valainis (Greens and Farmers Union), has approached the Saeima’s Committee on Defence, Home Affairs and Corruption Prevention with a call to launch a discussion on a new mechanism for immigration controls, the Economics Ministry said in a release on July 30.

latvia.title: Latvian climber who survived fall on Denali returns to Rīga
latvia.description: On the evening of Tuesday, 28 July, Mārtiņš Bilzēns, a member of the Latvian mountaineering group who had been seriously injured, returned to Latvia from Alaska.

latvia.title: Rīga's parks to host musical performances throughout August
latvia.description: This year, Riga will be celebrating its 825th anniversary, and everyone is invited to attend the wide-ranging festive events. Throughout August, the capital’s evenings will be filled with music from the park concert series at the Dzegužkalns Open-Air Stage, Ziemeļblāzma Palace Park and Vērmane Garden.

latvia.title: Off-duty police officer drives drunk, crashes, flees scene
latvia.description: On Wednesday evening, the State Police in Aizkraukle arrested an off-duty police officer – a senior inspector – who, whilst under the influence of alcohol with a blood alcohol level of 3.18 per mille, caused a road traffic accident and subsequently fled the scene, the State Police reported.

latvia.title: Latvia's power distribution network to expand further
latvia.description: The state-owned company AS ‘Sadales tīkls’ (ST) will build two new substations in Saulkrasti and Saldus, as well as modernise the existing infrastructure in Salacgrīva, thereby enabling new electricity producers and consumers to be connected to the grid, the company announced on July 30.

latvia.title: Does the Saeima provide good value for money?
latvia.description: In the pre-election period it is perhaps not surprising that many politicians are trying to polish their credentials as money-managers, calling for controlled spending, probes in NGO funding, a review of scientific research costs and various other fiscal discipline measures.

latvia.title: Latvia's Interior Minister calls for investigation of police chief
latvia.description: Minister for the Interior Jānis Dombrava (National Alliance) is set to call for an internal investigation into State Police (VP) Chief Armands Ruks in connection with "various systematic breaches" in the State Police’s operations, including an incident in Priekule where a drunk police officer killed a man, notably whilst off duty.

latvia.title: 'Horos' contemporary dance festival comes to Rīga
latvia.description: On July 30th and 31st, Rīga will host the contemporary dance festival "Horos", which has moved from Aizpute to the capital for the first time.

latvia.title: Liepāja street upgrades set to continue
latvia.description: The road surfacing programme will continue in Liepāja until 2030, reports Latvian Radio, though not everyone is happy with the results so far.

latvia.title: Causes of Pitbull show cancellation to be investigated
latvia.description: There will be no new Pitbull concert in the near future, Ģirts Majors, head of the concert organiser “Positivus Music”, said on the Latvian Television programme “Morning Panorama” on July 30.

latvia.title: Latvia will get hotter on Thursday
latvia.description: Forecasts suggest that the weather in Latvia will become hotter on Thursday.

latvia.title: Balticovo builds flats for employees in Iecava, Latvia
latvia.description: The poultry farming company AS ‘Balticovo’ has invested more than two million euros in a staff apartment block project in Iecava, the company announced on July 29.

latvia.title: Roadworks in central Rīga set to begin
latvia.description: Construction of the cycle path along 11 November Embankment will begin with the section from Akmens Bridge to Dzelzceļa Bridge, where the first construction works are due to start in August. Meanwhile, on Ģertrūdes Street, the section from Aleksandra Čaka Street to Krišjāņa Barona Street will be renovated, Rīga City Council said.

latvia.title: Security guard appears in Latvian court on suspicion of spying for Russia
latvia.description: On July 29th a former store security guard was led into a Rīga court in handcuffs, accused not only of espionage, but also of hooliganism and robbery.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 29th July, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Police: Unauthorised gathering is illegal, Pitbull-themed or not
latvia.description: Following the cancellation of singer Pitbull’s concert, which was due to take place on 29 July at the Mežaparks Grand Open-Air Stage, calls have been made on social media and other online platforms for people to gather at the planned concert venue nonetheless. The State Police point out that such calls are unlawful.

latvia.title: Estonia sending more border guards to help Latvia
latvia.description: Estonian public media ERR News reports that Estonia will send additional police and border guard forces to Latvia to strengthen the European Union's external border.

latvia.title: Dementia a bigger problem in Latvia than figures suggest
latvia.description: In Latvia, just over 5,000 people have been officially diagnosed with dementia, but using internationally recognized methodology, it is estimated that the real number with the condition could reach as many as 38,000 [Data from the non-governmental organization “Alzheimer Europe”] according to a release from the Society Integration Fund (SIF).

latvia.title: Latvia's retail sector enjoyed a strong June
latvia.description: Calendar adjusted data (at constant prices) compiled by the Central Statistical Bureau (CSB) and published on July 29th show that, compared to June 2025, in June 2026 Latvia's total retail trade turnover rose by 4.8 %.

latvia.title: Rīga's hotels also affected by cancelled Pitbull show
latvia.description: Just one day before the event, the concert by American musician Pitbull in Mežaparks has been cancelled. The hospitality sector is also already facing cancellations of bookings, whilst the Consumer Rights Protection Centre will be monitoring the situation to ensure that consumer rights are upheld, namely that the money spent on tickets is refunded, Latvan Radio reported on July 29.

latvia.title: Forum Cinemas to take over Cinamon in Rīga
latvia.description: The Competition Council (KP) has authorised the subsidiary of “Forum Cinemas Latvia OU” (Forum Cinemas) to acquire the lease rights to premises adapted for cinema use in the ‘Akropole Alfa’ shopping centre, where SIA ‘Cinamon Operations Latvia’ (‘Cinamon’) currently operates, the KP announced Wednesday.

latvia.title: Latvia-Ukraine driving licence parity coming in September
latvia.description: From September 2nd, 2026, an agreement between Latvia and Ukraine on the mutual recognition and exchange of driving licences will enter into force, which will allow nationals of both countries to exchange driving licences issued in their own country for a driving licence of the other country without the need to take a test.

latvia.title: Over 100 drug hiding spots found in criminal case in Latvia
latvia.description: Following the admission of a young woman to Kuldīga Hospital last September after suffering drug poisoning, the State Police arrested a man and launched an investigation, during which they discovered more than 100 drug dens in the forests around Jelgava and Jūrmala. The criminal case has been referred to the Prosecutor’s Office, the State Police reported.

latvia.title: Booze sales restrictions have not changed consumption much in Latvia
latvia.description: The restrictions on the sale of alcoholic beverages, introduced a year ago, have not significantly reduced alcohol purchases, but have changed shoppers’ buying habits, with people adjusting the times at which they shop, according to retailers surveyed by the LETA news agency on July 29.

latvia.title: New industrial park planned for Rēzekne
latvia.description: A new industrial park is being planned north of Rēzekne in eastern Latvia which should be one of the most significant city development projects in the coming years.

latvia.title: Any Russian 'little green men' will be neutralised, says Latvian Defence Minister
latvia.description: Currently, a direct military, conventional Russian attack on NATO is not possible, and stating this is not just an attempt to calm public fears of conflict, Latvian Defence Minister Raivis Melnis said in an interview with the LETA newswire.

latvia.title: Latvian police forces could introduce daily alcohol testing
latvia.description: Following the tragedy in Priekule, the State Police might introduce alcohol tests at the start of the working day as a preventative measure, particularly for officers who carry a weapon or drive a service vehicle, Interior Minister Jānis Dombrava (National Alliance) said in an interview with Latvian Radio on July 29.

latvia.title: Ukrainian aid organisation continues work after warehouse fire
latvia.description: The “Tavi draugi” association is continuing its work, despite a potentially malicious fire last week in which a large proportion of the aid intended for Ukrainians was destroyed. Several businesspeople have offered the association premises, and the local council is also considering options. However, for the time being, volunteers are carrying on with their work in temporary tents, Latvian Television reported on July 28.

latvia.title: Latvia's eastern border to be reinforced until end of 2027
latvia.description: On Tuesday, the Government took note of a report from the Ministry of the Interior on the construction of infrastructure along the country’s eastern border. Work is scheduled to be completed by the end of this year, although the State Real Estate (VNĪ) plans to continue work on certain sections until the end of next year, Latvian Radio reported July 28.

latvia.title: Pitbull Rīga show cancelled last minute due to 'technical issues'
latvia.description: Due to technical issues that arose during the set-up for the concert, the scheduled Pitbull concert at the Mežaparks Grand Open-Air Stage in Rīga on 29 July has been cancelled, according to organisers.

latvia.description: Data on viral hepatitis published by Eurostat to mark World Hepatitis Day, observed each year on 28 July, comes with mixed news for Latvia.

latvia.title: Latvian government approves hospital reform
latvia.description: On Tuesday 28 July, following lengthy discussions, the Government endorsed the hospital network reform drawn up by the Ministry of Health (VM), which provides for the introduction of three tiers of hospitals – local, regional and multi-speciality – from next year, replacing the current five-tier system.

latvia.title: Foreign students could be subjected to stricter admission rules in future
latvia.description: In preparation for the new academic year, some higher education institutions are promising to tighten their entry requirements for international students from third countries, Latvian Radio reported on July 28.

latvia.title: Expect jams on Rīga-Liepāja highway this weekend
latvia.description: This coming weekend, on 31 July and 1 August, the “Summer Sound 2026” festival will take place on Liepāja beach, so congestions are expected on the highway, according to the Road Traffic Safety Directorate (CSDD).

latvia.title: Rain damaged 53 road sections in Talsi vicinity last week
latvia.description: Last week’s heavy rain in Talsi Municipality has caused damage to 53 sections of road, Ansis Bērziņš, Chair of Talsi Municipal Council, told the LETA news agency on July 28.

latvia.title: Woman steals thousands from neighbour's bank account
latvia.description: In Kuldīga municipality, a woman unlawfully took more than 3,000 euros from a bank account from someone who had trusted her, according to the State Police.

latvia.title: Farmers in western Latvia struggle to harvest grain
latvia.description: For the most part, Latvia has good potential for a grain harvest this year, although in many places the rain is currently delaying the harvest. The situation is better in Zemgale, Latgale and Vidzeme, but farmers in Kurzeme are currently facing the greatest difficulties, where the rainfall has also washed out roads in many places, Latvian Radio reported on July 28.

latvia.title: Mere no more: discount chain falls foul of sanctions
latvia.description: Until recently here were 12 "Mere" stores in Latvia, in Rīga, Liepāja, Tukums, Jēkabpils and other cities, but now they have been closed because one of Mere's owners - Russian businessman Sergey Schneider - is included in the European Union (EU) sanctions list.

latvia.title: Latvia's largest landfill will be full within 10 years
latvia.description: In Latvia, over the last ten years, the amount of household waste per capita per year has increased by around 100 kilograms. The capacity of the Getliņi landfill site will, at best, be exhausted within the next ten years, Imants Stirāns, Chairman of the Board of SIA “Getliņi eko”, told the LETA news agency.

latvia.title: Twenty Rīga schools still have spots for high schoolers
latvia.description: A total of 4,869 applicants – or 91 per cent of those wishing to enrol – have been accepted to study in Year 10 at Rīga municipal schools, whilst there are still places available at around 20 schools, the Riga City Council’s External Communications Department told the LETA news agency.

latvia.title: Oil contamination found in river in Jelgava
latvia.description: Following a complaint from the public regarding possible contamination by petroleum products in the Driksa, a tributary of the Lielupe River, the State Environmental Service (VVD) carried out an inspection and found a film characteristic of petroleum products, VVD said on July 28.

latvia.title: Latvia's farms are mostly plugged into the internet
latvia.description: In 2023, about 43% of EU farms reported having internet access. Some northern and central European countries such as Denmark, Germany, Slovakia, Latvia, Czechia, and Austria, had rates above 90%, according to Eurostat data published on July 24th.

latvia.title: Donations sought to support work of Latvia's destroyed consulate in Ukraine
latvia.description: As previously reported, the building of the Latvian Honorary Consulate in Sloviansk was severely damaged in a Russian airstrike on July 24th. Now The "Entrepreneurs for Peace" Foundation, in cooperation with journalist Ieva Vārna, is launching a fundraising campaign to help Honorary Consul Oleksandr Pavenko equip new premises for the Latvian representation in the Donetsk region.

latvia.title: Charity donation drive will help kids get equipped for return to school
latvia.description: For many Latvian families, the start of the new school year in September brings not only the excitement of returning to school, but also significant financial and emotional pressure.

latvia.title: Gaisa Bridge in Rīga to be reconstructed
latvia.description: Rīga City Council has signed a contract with SIA ‘Projekts 3’ for the reconstruction of the Gaisa Bridge. The design work is scheduled to be completed in 2027, whilst the reconstruction of the Gaisa Bridge is due to be finished by 2030, the local authority has announced.

latvia.title: Coach arrested for alleged sexual abuse of child in Latvia
latvia.description: The police have launched criminal proceedings against a coach at the “Ogres novada Lāči” children’s and youth ice hockey club in connection with alleged sexual abuse of a child during a camp, Latvian Television reported on July 27.

lithuania.description: Feltételezhetően orosz rakéta csapódott be az ukrán határ közelében.

lithuania.title: Orosz rakéta tört be a NATO területére, súlyos támadás érte az ukrán hadiipart – Ukrajnai háborús híreink csütörtökön
lithuania.description: Kiadta a legfrissebb jelentését az ukrán légierő, ebben pontosan részletezik a július 30-i orosz támadást – számolt be az Ukrajinszka Pravda. A nagyszabású orosz támadás során rengeteg, különböző típusú rakétát vetettek be, ezek Ukrajna jelentős részén komoly károkat okoztak. Ott hajnalban riasztást kellett kiadni, ennek következtében az F-16-os vadászgépek is a levegőbe emelkedtek – közölte a TVP World. Később az orosz hatóságok megnevezték a ma hajnali támadás célpontjait, állításuk szerint nagyon súlyos csapásokat szenvedett el Ukrajna – közölte a Ria Novosztyi. Cikkünk folyamatosan frissül az orosz-ukrán háború legfrissebb eseményeivel.

lithuania.title: Najskôr sirény, potom 10-metrový kráter. NATO potvrdilo, že Poľsko zasiahla ruská raketa
lithuania.description: Raketa dopadla asi 90 kilometrov od ukrajinských hraníc.

lithuania.title: Kanadskou stážistku zadrženou ve velitelství NATO podezírají ze špionáže pro Čínu
lithuania.description: Kanaďanka pracující jako stážistka u NATO, která byla minulý týden zatčena v Belgii kvůli podezření ze špionáže, podle vyšetřovatelů zřejmě pracovala pro Čínu. S odvoláním na své zdroje o tom ve čtvrtek informovala agentura Reuters. Kanadská stanice CBC zároveň zveřejnila identitu zadržené ženy.

lithuania.title: Sbohem, Evropo. Pentagon zahájil revizi americké přítomnosti na starém kontinentě
lithuania.description: Spojené státy oficiálně zahájily komplexní revizi své vojenské přítomnosti v Evropě. Podle náměstka amerického ministra obrany Elbridge Colbyho má revize velmi jasný a nekompromisní cíl – přesunout břemeno konvenční obrany na evropské partnery. Pentagon již také informoval spojence v Evropě, že zahajuje globální snižování vojenských výdajů, včetně vybavení, které bylo dosud k dispozici pro operace NATO.

lithuania.title: Zadržená stážistka v NATO pracovala pro Čínu, píše Reuters
lithuania.description: Kanadská stážistka v NATO, kterou belgické úřady minulý pátek zadržely kvůli podezření ze špionáže, pracovala pro Čínu. Ve čtvrtek to s odvoláním na své zdroje napsala agentura Reuters. Belgická prokuratura, kanadské úřady ani orgány Severoatlantické aliance dosud neupřesnily, pro koho špionáž prováděla. Ve sdělení prokuratury se nicméně uvádí, že žena je kanadskou občankou čínského původu.

lithuania.title: Cancelarul Merz trage un semnal de alarmă după ce o rachetă rusească s-a prăbușit pe teritoriul NATO
lithuania.description: Pătrunderea unei rachete în spaţiul aerian polonez şi căderea acesteia în estul Poloniei, în timpul unui atac aerian rusesc masiv asupra Ucrainei, demonstrează „lipsa completă de scrupule a Rusiei” şi faptul că Moscova este „pregătită de o escaladare” a tensiunilor cu Europa, a declarat joi cancelarul german Friedrich Merz, relatează AFP şi Reuters.

lithuania.title: Stagiara acuzată de spionaj la NATO a lucrat și în alte instituții publice importante din Europa și Canada
lithuania.description: Nu e prima ei încercare? Firească întrebarea, căci profilul stagiarei acuzată de spionaj la NATO devine din ce în ce mai interesant. Canadiana de origine chineză suspectată de spionaj în timpul stagiului său la SHAPE din Mons a lucrat pentru mai multe instituții publice, după cum relevă o anchetă realizată de CBC News. Această femeie, Claire Biwei Zhang, are un CV impresionant, care include atât Agenția Spațială Europeană, cât și Organizația Mondială a Comerțului din Elveția, scrie 7sur7.be.

lithuania.title: NATO trimite în România avioane F-18 din Spania, elicoptere anti-dronă și 200 de militari iberici
lithuania.description: România va putea să doboare din elicopter dronele care intră pe teritoriul țării. NATO trimite șapte avioane de vânătoare F-18, trei elicoptere echipate antidronă și o aeronavă de realimentare în aer.

lithuania.title: CSM îi ia apărarea lui Marius Voineag, după jignirile aduse de Cristian Ghinea: Depășește cu mult libertatea de exprimare
lithuania.description: Consiliul Superior al Magistraturii, prin intermediul Secției pentru procurori, a intervenit pentru apărarea reputației profesionale a actualului adjunct al procurorului general, Marius Voineag, fostul șef al Direcției Naționale Anticorupție (DNA), pe fondul unei jigniri adresate de senatorul USR, Cristian Ghinea.

lithuania.title: NATO confirmă că obiectul prăbușit în estul Poloniei este „o rachetă rusească de tip necunoscut”
lithuania.description: Autoritățile poloneze investighează un loc al prăbușirii unui rachete rusești, în estul țării, în contextul în care avioane de vânătoare au fost mobilizate în noaptea de miercuri spre joi, ca răspuns la intensificarea activității militare a Rusiei în apropierea graniței cu Ucraina, informează TVP World.

lithuania.title: Ucrainenii au pierdut un avion de vânătoare F-16 în timpul unei misiuni de luptă. „Pilotul a fost nevoit să se catapulteze”
lithuania.description: Forțele Aeriene ale Ucrainei au anunțat miercuri că au pierdut contactul cu un avion de vânătoare F-16 în timpul unei misiuni de luptă, după ce aeronava a suferit o „situație de urgență” în zbor. Pilotul a reușit să se ejecteze și „se află în deplină siguranță”.

lithuania.title: Prima convorbire dintre Drapatîi și comandantul NATO: Ce a cerut Ucraina pentru a schimba soarta războiului cu Rusia
lithuania.description: Comandantul-șef al Armatei ucrainene, Mihailo Drapatîi, i-a prezentat generalului Alexus Grynkewich, comandantul suprem al Forțelor Aliate NATO în Europa, prioritățile Kievului pe câmpul de luptă. În prima discuție dintre cei doi, Drapatîi a vorbit despre consolidarea liniilor defensive, intensificarea loviturilor de precizie asupra forțelor ruse și nevoia Ucrainei de rachete Patriot.

lithuania.title: Anchetă de trădare în Franța: un fost pilot francez de avioane de vânătoare Rafale, cercetat pentru spionaj în favoarea Chinei
lithuania.description: Un fost pilot de Rafale din cadrul Marinei franceze a fost pus sub anchetă oficială la Paris pentru presupuse activități de spionaj în favoarea Chinei.

lithuania.title: Incendiu la un centru logistic al Wildberries din orașul rus Riazan, după un atac cu drone
lithuania.description: Instalaţii industriale din oraşul rus Riazan au luat foc în urma unui atac cu drone, afirmă guvernatorul regiunii, transmite Reuters.

lithuania.title: Daniel Zamfir, după ce a picat legea ANI: „Amendamentul n-a fost făcut pentru Dominic Fritz. Sunt câteva mii de aleși locali în această situație”
lithuania.description: Liderul senatorilor PSD, Daniel Zamfir, a declarat că amendamentul care stabilea încetarea mandatului pentru aleșii locali declarați în stare de conflict de interese nu i s-ar fi aplicat doar primarului Timișoarei, Dominic Fritz de la USR, „că situația lui nu este unică”. Legea ANI, unul dintre jaloanele necesare pentru accesarea banilor rămași în PNRR, a …

lithuania.title: CSM îi apără reputația lui Marius Voineag, adjunctul Parchetului General / Fostul șef DNA fusese numit „ticălos”, ”psihopat”, ”gibon borfaș”, ”cocalar”, ”manelist” de senatorul USR Cristian Ghinea: ”Depășește cu mult libertatea de exprimare”
lithuania.description: Secția pentru procurori din cadrul Consiliului Superior al Magistraturii a decis, în ședința de joi, să îi apere reputația profesională lui Marius Voineag, procurorul șef adjunct al Parchetului General. Decizia vine în urma unui derapaj verbal înregistrat de senatorul USR Cristian Ghinea, care l-a numit pe fostul șef DNA „ticălos”, ”psihopat”, ”gibon borfaș”, ”cocalar”, ”cu […] © G4Media.ro .

lithuania.title: O stagiară canadiană la NATO, arestată sub suspiciunea de spionaj / Ar fi lucrat pentru China, în departamentul IT al organizației nord-atlantice (surse Reuters)
lithuania.description: Autoritățile din Belgia suspectează că o stagiară canadiană la NATO, care a fost arestată sub acuzația de spionaj, lucra pentru China, potrivit Reuters, transmite Mediafax. Autoritățile belgiene suspectează faptul că stagiara de origine canadiană la NATO, care a fost arestată sub acuzația de spionaj, lucra în favoarea Chinei. Două surse familiarizate cu cazul au dezvăluit […] © G4Media.ro .

lithuania.title: Turkish Airlines: Entry into Russian airspace was a one‑off weather-related decision
lithuania.description: Turkish Airlines, whose July 12 flight from Tallinn to Istanbul briefly entered Kaliningrad airspace, says the deviation was a one‑time safety‑driven exception caused by adverse weather conditions.

lithuania.title: BLOGI ⟩ 1619. sõjapäev Ukrainas: Zelenskõi andmetel kasutas Venemaa õhurünnakus Põhja-Korea raketti
lithuania.description: 2022. aasta 24. veebruaril alustas Venemaa režiimi juht Vladimir Putin sissetungi Ukrainasse. Pärast seda, kui Ukraina lõi tagasi pealetungi Kiievile, on lahingute kese kandunud Ida- ja Lõuna-Ukrainasse. Postimees kajastab 1619. sõjapäeva sündmusi allolevas blogis.

lithuania.title: Poola kaalub Ukrainale täiendavate Patrioti rakettide andmist
lithuania.description: Poola peaminister Donald Tusk teatas neljapäeval, et Varssavi kaalub täiendavate Patrioti rakettide üleandmist Kiievile pärast seda, kui öösel kukkus Ida-Poolas põllule Vene rakett, teatas ajaleht Kyiv Independent.

lithuania.title: Bildt: Putini kangekaelsus veab teda Ukrainas halvima suunas
lithuania.description: Venemaa diktaator Vladimir Putin peaks nõustuma relvarahuga Ukrainas praegusel kontaktjoonel, mis on talle praeguses olukorras parim valik, avaldas neljapäeval väljaande Kyiv Independent külaliskolumnis arvamust Rootsi endine peaminister ja välisminister Carl Bildt.

lithuania.title: Zelenskõi andmetel kasutas Venemaa õhurünnakus Põhja-Korea raketti
lithuania.description: Esialgsed andmed viitavad sellele, et Venemaa kasutas Dnipropetrovski oblastis asuva Radušne küla ründamiseks Põhja-Korea ballistilist raketti, ütles neljapäeval Ukraina president Volodõmõr Zelenskõi.

lithuania.title: Any Russian 'little green men' will be neutralised, says Latvian Defence Minister
lithuania.description: Currently, a direct military, conventional Russian attack on NATO is not possible, and stating this is not just an attempt to calm public fears of conflict, Latvian Defence Minister Raivis Melnis said in an interview with the LETA newswire.

lithuania.title: Krievijai klājas arvien grūtāk: Kremlis spiests pieņemt jaunus ierobežojumus
lithuania.description: Krievijā pilnīgs benzīna eksporta aizliegums būs spēkā līdz 2027. gada 31. janvārim, savukārt aizliegums eksportēt dīzeļdegvielu un kuģu degvielu pagarināts līdz septembrim, teikts Krievijas valdības paziņojumā. Par plāniem pagarināt benzīna eksporta aizliegumu līdz gada beigām pagājušajā nedēļā paziņoja premjerministra vietnieks Aleksandrs Novaks. Pašreizējie ierobežojumi beidzas 31. jūlijā. Benzīna un citu degvielu trūkumu Krievijā izraisīja Ukrainas […]

lithuania.title: “Vācieties prom!” Polijas ārlietu ministrs nosauc vienīgo valsti, kas spētu nekavējoties piespiest Putinu izbeigt karu Ukrainā
lithuania.description: Ķīnai ir reāli instrumenti, kas ļautu piespiest Krieviju izbeigt karu Ukrainā, taču Pekina to nedara, jo pašreizējā situācija tai ir izdevīga. Tā uzskata Polijas ārlietu ministrs Radoslavs Sikorskis, kurš par to izteicās podkāstā “The Long Game”. Pēc ministra domām, Pekina varētu izdarīt spēcīgu ekonomisku spiedienu uz Maskavu, jo Krievija lielā mērā ir atkarīga no tirdzniecības […]

lithuania.title: Pēc satraucošajiem notikumiem Polijā NATO atklāj jaunas detaļas par objektu, kas ielidoja un nogāzās valsts teritorijā
lithuania.description: Šodien jau vēstījām, ka, kemēr Krievija naktī īstenoja plašus triecienus Ukrainā, satraucošs incidents fiksēts arī Polijā. Valsts gaida telpā pamanīta neidentificēts lidojošs objekts, bet vēlāk netālu no Tarnavas-Koloņas ciema Ļubļinas vojevodistē atklāta vieta, kur tas nogāzies. Par notikušo, atsaucoties uz Polijas Bruņoto spēku Operatīvo pavēlniecību, vēstīja TVP World. Tagad NATO apstiprinājusi, ka Polijas teritorijā nogāzusies […]

lithuania.title: Orai.lt: karštį malšins vasariškos liūtys
lithuania.description: Šiandien pirmoji dienos pusė išliks sausesnė, saulėtesnė. Po vidudienio iš vakarų prie Lietuvos artinsis banguotas šaltasis atmosferos frontas. Įsivyraus nepastovus debesuotumas. Vietomis praslinks trumpos liūtys su perkūnija.

lithuania.title: Pašinianas pagrasino Putinui, kad pareikalaus iš Rusijos 2 milijardų dolerių
lithuania.description: Armėnija gali pareikalauti iš Rusijos iki 1,73 mlrd. eurų (2 mlrd. JAV dolerių) per metus už savo geležinkelių infrastruktūros nuomą, jei nepavyks susitarti dėl koncesijos sąlygų peržiūros, pareiškė ministras pirmininkas Nikolas Pašinianas, rašo „The Moscow Times“.

lithuania.title: Volodymyras Zelenskis: daugiavaikę šeimą pražudžiusi raketa galėjo būti patiekta Šiaurės Korėjos
lithuania.description: Raketa, kuri per naujausius Rusijos smūgius pražudė mažiausiai šešis tos pačios šeimos narius, galėjo būti patiekta Pchenjano, ketvirtadienį pareiškė Ukrainos prezidentas Volodymyras Zelenskis.

lithuania.title: „Pinigai sadistams ir teroristams“: rado „kaltininkus“ dėl gaisrų Prancūzijoje
lithuania.description: Socialiniuose tinkluose platinamas įrašas, kuriame Prancūzijos ir Ispanijos miškų gaisrai siejami su šių šalių parama Ukrainai. Įrašas beveik pažodžiui atkartoja Rusijos valstybinės propagandos kanalo RT publikaciją, kurioje gamtinė nelaimė pasitelkiama menkinti Europos valstybes, diskredituoti pagalbą Kyjivui ir kurti tariamo Rusijos pranašumo įspūdį.

lithuania.title: Pavelas Durovas sako, kad Rusija paskelbė jį teroristu už atsisakymą vykdyti cenzūros reikalavimus
lithuania.description: „Telegram“ įkūrėjas Pavelas Durovas ketvirtadienį pareiškė, kad Rusija paskelbė jį „teroristu“, nes jis atsisakė vykdyti Maskvos reikalavimus dėl „masinio stebėjimo ir cenzūros“ jo populiarioje susirašinėjimo platformoje.

lithuania.title: Pasaulio galingiausieji pradeda nematomą kovą už uždarų durų: renkamas įtakingas įpėdinis
lithuania.description: Ketvirtadienį JT Saugumo Taryba pradeda slaptus neoficialius balsavimo raundus, skirtus išrinkti kitą generalinį sekretorių. Po slaptų balsavimų paaiškės, kas gali tapti Antonio Guterreso įpėdiniu.

lithuania.title: Pareigūnė: pirmoji šiek tiek optimistiška diena pietvakarių Prancūzijoje nuo gaisrų pradžios
lithuania.description: Gaisrų nuniokotoje pietvakarių Prancūzijoje ketvirtadienis tapo „pirmąja šiek tiek optimistiška diena“ nuo tada, kai prieš daugiau nei savaitę kilo miškų gaisrai, pareiškė regiono prefektė.

lithuania.title: Ispanijoje dėl naujo gaisro netoli Portugalijos sienos teko evakuoti 800 žmonių
lithuania.description: Vakarų Ispanijoje netoli Portugalijos sienos siaučiantis naujas miško gaisras per 24 valandas nuniokojo 11 tūkst. hektarų plotą ir privertė evakuoti 800 žmonių, ketvirtadienį pranešė pareigūnai.

lithuania.title: Kvietimus studijuoti aukštosiose mokyklose gavo 21,7 tūkst. stojančiųjų – 3,8 proc. daugiau
lithuania.description: Kvietimus studijuoti aukštosiose mokyklose šiemet gavo 21,7 tūkst. stojančiųjų – 3,8 proc. daugiau nei pernai (20,9 tūkst.), ketvirtadienį pranešė Švietimo, mokslo ir sporto ministerija (ŠMSM).

lithuania.title: Paieškų istorija baigėsi dramatiškai, bet susitelkimas sušildė: po mirties skelbiama padėka
lithuania.description: Alytaus rajone buvo sutelktos pajėgos ir dedamos didžiulės pastangos, ieškant be žinios dingusio žmogaus. Net ir po tragiškos atomazgos artimieji stengiasi įžvelgti teigiamų dalykų bei už juos viešai dėkoja: nelaimės akivaizdoje sulaukta labai svarbios pagalbos.

lithuania.title: Naujosios Zelandijos diplomatijos vadovas sulaukė Kinijos ambasados skundo dėl rasizmo
lithuania.description: Pekino ambasada Naujojoje Zelandijoje ketvirtadienį pranešė pateikusi oficialų skundą dėl to, kad šios šalies užsienio reikalų ministras Winstonas Petersas (Vinstonas Petersas) kinų kilmės įstatymų leidėjui pasakė „grįžti į savo šalį“.

lithuania.title: Signatarai apie Kazimirą Prunskienę: ryški lyderė, kurią lydėjo ir prieštaringi sprendimai
lithuania.description: Lietuvos nepriklausomybės akto signatarai ketvirtadienį mirusią pirmąją atkurtos nepriklausomos šalies premjerę Kazimirą Danutę Prunskienę prisimena kaip vieną ryškiausių to meto lyderių, kurią lydėjo ir prieštaringi sprendimai.

lithuania.title: Prokuratūra: Lenkijoje nukritusioje sparnuotojoje raketoje buvo „didelis“ kiekis sprogmenų
lithuania.description: Sparnuotojoje raketoje, įskridusioje į Lenkijos teritoriją ir nukritusioje lauke, buvo „didelis“ kiekis sprogmenų, pranešė prokuratūra, kurią cituoja „TVP World“.
